items.front: India's crude-oil import dependence and largest generation source?
items.back: ~85-88% of crude oil imported; coal is still the largest source of electricity generation (~70%+).
items.examPoint: Energy demand, per-capita consumption & import dependence (crude oil ~85-88% imported)

items.back: 500 GW non-fossil by 2030; 50% RE; cut 1 Gt CO₂; 45% emission-intensity cut; net-zero by 2070.
items.examPoint: 500 GW non-fossil by 2030 target (Panchamrit/COP26) & 50% non-fossil-capacity milestone reached in 2025 (ahead of NDC)

items.back: India hit 50% non-fossil installed capacity in 2025 (ahead of NDC); total installed capacity crossed ~500 GW.
items.examPoint: Installed capacity 2025-26 — total crossed 500 GW; renewable/non-fossil figures

items.front: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Feb 2024)?
items.back: Rooftop solar for 1 crore homes; up to 300 free units/month; outlay ₹75,021 cr.
items.examPoint: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana (Feb 2024) — rooftop solar, 1 crore homes, up to 300 free units, Rs 75,021 cr

items.front: National Green Hydrogen Mission — year, outlay, target?
items.back: Jan 2023; ₹19,744 cr; ~5 MMT/year by 2030. SIGHT incentivises electrolysers + production. Green = electrolysis via RE.
items.examPoint: National Green Hydrogen Mission (2023) — Rs 19,744 cr outlay, 5 MMT/year by 2030

items.back: 1: PHWR (natural U → Pu). 2: FBR (breeds Pu, starts Th cycle). 3: Thorium-U233 breeders. PFBR Kalpakkam fuelled 2024.
items.examPoint: Nuclear three-stage programme (Homi Bhabha) — PHWR to FBR to thorium-U233 breeders

items.back: Monazite in coastal beach sands (Kerala, Odisha, Tamil Nadu, Andhra). Large thorium, limited uranium → drives Stage 3.
items.examPoint: India's thorium reserves (monazite beach sands, Kerala/Andhra) & strategic significance

items.front: DAE bodies: NPCIL, BHAVINI, IGCAR, BARC roles?
items.back: NPCIL = commercial plants; BHAVINI = PFBR; IGCAR = fast-reactor R&D (Kalpakkam); BARC = research (Trombay).
items.examPoint: DAE institutions & reactors — BARC, IGCAR, NPCIL, BHAVINI; PFBR Kalpakkam; Kudankulam

items.back: ₹20,000 cr for SMR R&D; ≥5 indigenous SMRs by 2033; 100 GW nuclear by 2047 (from ~8-9 GW today).
items.examPoint: Nuclear Energy Mission (Budget 2025-26) — SMRs, Rs 20,000 cr R&D, 100 GW nuclear by 2047

items.back: ~20% ethanol blending (E20) achieved ~2025 (from sugarcane/molasses/grain). SATAT promotes Compressed Bio-Gas from waste.
items.examPoint: Bioenergy — ethanol blending E20 (achieved 2025), CBG/SATAT, waste-to-energy

items.front: Energy efficiency: BEE, PAT, UJALA, star labelling?
items.back: BEE = statutory body (EC Act 2001); PAT = trade ESCerts (industry); UJALA = LED distribution; star labelling = appliance ratings.
items.examPoint: Energy efficiency — BEE, star labelling, PAT scheme, UJALA

items.back: Pinnapuram (Kurnool) integrated PSP; Kurnool UMSP ~1000 MW (Panyam); Pudimadaka NTPC green-H2 hub (Anakapalli, ~1200 TPD).
items.examPoint: Andhra Pradesh energy — pumped storage (Pinnapuram, world's largest), solar/wind, AP clean energy policy

items.front: AP renewables total (2026) and 2047 target; APGENCO vs APTRANSCO?
items.back: ~14,833 MW RE commissioned (solar-led); target ~160 GW green by 2047. APGENCO=generation, APTRANSCO=transmission.
items.examPoint: AP energy target — 160 GW green energy by 2047 & large pumped-storage pipeline
